name: Third-party hosted form
summary: A form that looks like part of the site is hosted by a third party that profiles on its own account.

mechanism.what: A signup, contact or newsletter form lives on a domain belonging to a marketing platform. The visitor believes they are dealing with the site; the platform sets its own identifiers and builds its own record.
mechanism.why_it_matters: The visitor cannot see who they are actually handing data to. Interest categories ticked on such a form become a profile at a party the person never chose.
common_causes: marketing platform hosting the form on a vendor subdomain
embedded form in an iframe from another registrable domain
mechanism.not_this: A processor hosting a form under the controller's own domain and instructions is not this entry.

detection.indicator: Set-Cookie from a host under a different registrable domain than the site that linked to the form, at page load and before any submission.
capture_requirements: never submit the form; establish the fields, not the processing after sending
record the fields offered, since that shows what profile would be built

falsifiers.condition: The cookies are strictly necessary to operate the form.
The form domain is a CNAME under the controller's own domain, operated as a processor.

methods.expect: no dedicated reproduction exists yet; follow the general method and the indicator above

rebuttals.objection: That is our supplier's platform, not our site.
rebuttals.answer: Fashion ID holds that a controller who arranges for visitor data to reach a third party is jointly responsible for that collection and transmission. Linking to the form is arranging it.

does_not_establish: harm; the catalogue standardises a finding so it can be referred to, it does not weigh it
severity; there is no score here, by design. Weighing belongs to whoever applies the entry to a concrete case
unlawfulness; that is for a supervisory authority or a court
intent; a fault is usually a build decision, not a plan
absence: not finding it in one capture is not evidence that it is not there
summary_nl: Een formulier dat bij de site lijkt te horen, staat bij een derde die voor eigen rekening profileert.

in_practice.dpia: Verify who actually hosts each form and what it sets, rather than treating a supplier form as an internal one.
in_practice.procurement: Forms are served from the controller's own domain, or the third-party host sets nothing before submission.
in_practice.complaint: A capture of the form page at load, showing the host and the cookies it sets.
in_practice.audit_question: When someone fills in your contact form, whose domain are they on?
in_practice.audit_question_nl: Als iemand uw contactformulier invult, op wiens domein staat hij dan?
in_practice.complaint_nl: Een opname of uitdraai die laat zien wat er werkelijk gebeurt, met de datum erbij en het land van waaruit is gemeten.
in_practice.objection_nl: Dat is het platform van onze leverancier, niet onze site.
in_practice.answer_nl: Wie regelt dat bezoekersgegevens bij een derde belanden, is daarvoor medeverantwoordelijk.
